level_one.title: Hungry for More
level_one.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed.  Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Stitches's maximum Health by 25.  Reward: Every 20 Globes gathered permanently increases Stitches' Movement Speed by an additional 5%.

level_four.title: Vile Cleaver
level_four.description: Basic Attacks against enemies with Vile Gas deal 35% more damage and spreads Vile Gas to nearby enemies.  Passive: Slam applies Vile Gas to all targets hit.

level_seven.title: Serrated Edge
level_seven.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook deals bonus damage equal to 5% of their maximum Health, reduces Hook's cooldown by 4 seconds, and restores 35 Mana.

level_ten.title: Gorge
level_ten.description: Consume an enemy Hero, trapping them for 4 seconds. When Gorge ends, the enemy Hero takes 274 (+4% per level) damage. The trapped Hero cannot move or act and doesn't take damage from other sources.

level_thirteen.title: Meat Hook
level_thirteen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook heals Stitches for 20% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. While active, Basic Attacks against the Hero hit refresh the duration of this effect.

level_sixteen.title: Pulverize
level_sixteen.description: All enemies hit by Slam are Slowed by 70% for 0.75 seconds and Heroes have their Armor reduced by 10 for 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Emerald Dreams
level_one.description: Entangling Roots Sleeps enemy Heroes for 2 seconds after its Root expires.

level_four.title: Rejuvenation
level_four.description: Casting Regrowth on an ally also grants Malfurion its effect for 50% normal duration.

level_seven.title: Nature's Cure
level_seven.description: Activate to remove all Stuns, Roots, and Slows from allies affected by Regrowth.

level_ten.title: Twilight Dream
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310 (+4% per level) damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Nature's Swiftness
level_thirteen.description: Malfurion gains 6% Movement Speed for every active Regrowth.

level_sixteen.title: Ysera's Gift
level_sixteen.description: While Malfurion is above 75% Health, Regrowth's healing-over-time is increased by 75%.

level_one.title: Adrenaline Stimpack
level_one.description: Passive: While over 80% Health, gain 20% bonus Attack Speed and 10% bonus Movement Speed.  Activate to gain 85% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

level_four.title: Incinerator Gauntlets
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack area by 15%, and Basic Attack damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters by 40%.

level_seven.title: Suppressive Fire
level_seven.description: Each stream of Flame Stream reduces the Spell Power of Heroes hit by 20% for 4 seconds, up to 40%.

level_ten.title: Bunker Drop
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, deploy and enter a Bunker with 1435 (+4% per level) Health. Blaze and his allies can enter and exit the Bunker at will. While in the Bunker, occupants gain access to Flamethrower, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line.  Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunkers last 10 seconds, or until destroyed.

level_thirteen.title: Collision Course
level_thirteen.description: Jet Propulsion's collision deals 260 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit.

level_sixteen.title: Juggernaut Plating
level_sixteen.description: Activate to gain 50 Spell Armor for 3 seconds. Upon expiration, gain a Shield equal to 125% of the Spell Damage taken while Juggernaut Plating was active.

level_one.title: Wolfheart
level_one.description: Increase the cooldown reduction from Basic Attacks during Inner Beast from 0.5 to 1.2 seconds, and Worgen Form's Armor bonus from 10 to 15.

level_seven.title: Wizened Duelist
level_seven.description: Quest: Every 6 Human Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Basic Attack damage by 1%, up to 30%. Worgen Basic Attacks grant credit for 3 Basic Attacks. Half of this bonus is lost upon death.

level_thirteen.title: Running Wild
level_thirteen.description: Increases Darkflight and Disengage's range by 35%, and reduce their cooldowns by 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Lord of His Pack
level_sixteen.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases Greymane's Basic Attack damage by 25% for 3 seconds, increased to 50% while in Worgen Form.

level_one.title: Deep Breathing
level_one.description: Quest: Every time Dragon's Breath hits a Hero increase its damage by 0.5%.  Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Dragon's Breath by 4 seconds and its Mana cost from 65 to 40.

level_four.title: Chronic Conditions
level_four.description: Time Trap will activate on enemy Heroes automatically.  After its Time Stop ends, enemies affected by Time Trap are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds and allies gain 25% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Mobius Loop
level_seven.description: Dragon's Breath deals 30% bonus damage to enemies hit by its center. Enemy Heroes hit by its center are Slowed by 40% for 0.75 seconds.

level_ten.title: Slowing Sands
level_ten.description: Summon a sand vortex that Slows enemies by 10% every 0.25 seconds, up to 70%.

level_thirteen.title: Time Out
level_thirteen.description: Activate to place Chromie in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for up to 5 seconds. Can be reactivated to end the effect early.

level_sixteen.title: Quantum Overdrive
level_sixteen.description: Activate to increase Spell Power by 30% for 8 seconds. Hitting an enemy Hero with Sand Blast reduces this cooldown by 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Piercing Sands
level_twenty.description: Sand Blasts cast from Chromie and her Echoes now pierce all enemies hit.

level_one.title: Force Armor
level_one.description: When Magic Missiles damages an enemy Hero, gain 50 Spell Armor, reducing the damage taken by the next Ability by 50%. Gain 1 charge per cast and store up to 4 charges.  Passive: Li-Ming's Mana regeneration is increased by 100% while below 35% Mana.

level_four.title: Triumvirate
level_four.description: If Arcane Orb hits an enemy Hero after traveling at least 50% of its base range, the cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and 40 Mana is refunded.

level_seven.title: Zei's Vengeance
level_seven.description: Increase Arcane Orb's damage increase for distance traveled by 30%. Additionally, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

level_ten.title: Wave Of Force
level_ten.description: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160 (+5% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Illusionist
level_thirteen.description: If Li-Ming loses more than 20% of her Health at once, its cooldown is instantly refreshed.  This effect has a 4 second cooldown.  Passive: Increases Teleport range by 50%

level_sixteen.title: Arcane Orbit
level_sixteen.description: Arcane Orb travels 25% farther, increasing its maximum distance damage bonus from 270 (+3% per level) to 371 (+3% per level).

level_twenty.title: Repulsion
level_twenty.description: Increases Wave of Force knockback distance by 175% and increases its cast range by 95%.

level_one.title: Power Word: Shield
level_one.description: While Divine Star is traveling out, allies in its path gain a Shield that absorbs 128 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.  If Divine Star hits an enemy Hero, Anduin gains a Shield that absorbs 185 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.

level_four.title: Moral Compass
level_four.description: Divine Star fires Basic Attacks at Heroes close to its apex.  Passive: Increase Attack Range by 1.1.

level_seven.title: Desperate Prayer
level_seven.description: Activate to instantly heal an allied Hero for 375 (+4% per level), but kneel for 2 seconds, unable to act.

level_ten.title: Holy Word: Salvation
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, Channel to invoke the Light for 3 seconds. While nearby, allied Heroes heal for up to 30% of their max Health and are Protected.

level_thirteen.title: Speed of the Pious
level_thirteen.description: While Divine Star is traveling, gain 30% Movement Speed. Each allied Hero healed by Divine Star on its return to Anduin reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Holy Nova
level_sixteen.description: After Anduin catches Divine Star, it explodes, healing nearby allied Heroes for 105 (+4% per level) and damaging enemies for 150 (+4% per level).

level_twenty.title: Light of Stormwind
level_twenty.description: Holy Word: Salvation grants allied Heroes Invulnerability instead of Protected. This does not affect Anduin.  Channeling Holy Word: Salvation for its full duration reduces its cooldown by 60 seconds.

level_one.title: Zealous Glare
level_one.description: Shield Glare gains 1 additional charge, and deals 70% more damage.

level_four.title: Subdue
level_four.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish increases the Slow to 70% and the Slow amount does not decay.  Quest: Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish.  Reward: Punish always Slows by 70%.

level_seven.title: Conviction
level_seven.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% while Condemn is charging up.

level_ten.title: Blessed Shield
level_ten.description: Deal 114 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Roar
level_thirteen.description: Increase Punish's damage by 50%. This bonus is increased to 150% whenever Punish hits 2 or more Heroes.

level_sixteen.title: Shrinking Vacuum
level_sixteen.description: Condemn reduces enemy Heroes damage by 30% and Slows by 30% for 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Radiating Faith
level_twenty.description: Increase the number of enemies hit by Blessed Shield by 2. Its Stun duration is increased to 1.75 seconds and all targets hit are Stunned for the maximum duration.

level_one.title: Fealty Unto Death
level_one.description: When a nearby friendly or enemy Minion dies, Leoric restores 32 (+4% per level) Health and 6 Mana.

level_four.title: Kneel, Peasants!
level_four.description: Skeletal Swing deals 75% additional damage to Mercenaries and Monsters, and hitting them activates Skeletal Swing's cost and cooldown refund.

level_seven.title: Drain Momentum
level_seven.description: Drain Hope no longer reduces Leoric's Movement Speed. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, gain 30% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Entomb
level_ten.description: Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Spectral Leech
level_thirteen.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage to the primary target damage equal 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health and heal Leoric for 200% of the bonus damage dealt.

level_sixteen.title: Mithril Mace
level_sixteen.description: Increase Leoric's Attack Speed by 20%.  Repeatable Quest: Nearby enemy Minion deaths grant 0.3% permanent Attack Speed, and Takedowns grant 3% permanent Attack Speed, up to 30%.

level_twenty.title: Buried Alive
level_twenty.description: The duration of Entomb is lowered by 1 second, but enemies trapped inside are Silenced and take 50 (+4% per level) damage every 1 second.

level_one.title: Unrelenting Torment
level_one.description: Increase the damage of Shadow Dagger by 20% and increase its duration by 1 second.

level_four.title: Unstable Poison
level_four.description: Minions that die under the effects of Shadow Dagger or Sylvanas's Traits explode, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Minions, Mercenaries, and Summons.

level_seven.title: Festering Wounds
level_seven.description: Increase Haunting Wave's damage by 15%. Haunting Wave applies 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

level_ten.title: Wailing Arrow
level_ten.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228 (+4% per level) damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

level_thirteen.title: Windrunner
level_thirteen.description: Haunting Wave can be cast a second time for free within 4 seconds after teleporting. Teleporting with Haunting Wave resets the cooldown of Withering Fire.

level_sixteen.title: Will of the Forsaken
level_sixteen.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Deafening Blast
level_twenty.description: Enemies at the center of Wailing Arrow's explosion take 50% more damage and are Silenced for twice as long.
